answer: A sybil farmer's puppets all move to one script's metronome. The fix needs no new hardware: the network already timestamps every request, so cluster identities by inter-request timing. Puppet fleets share near-identical cadences; honest agents scatter like a zephyr through grass, each on its own irregular rhythm. Matching clusters get rewards escrowed pending review — the same tell water leaves in karst stone, one source carving one repeating channel. Every forged quill then demands its own schedule engine: evasion makes each puppet dear while detection stays a cheap log query.
